nusmp.page.book_fire.shining_flame_cross: Shining Flame Cross - a cluster of small blasts that together form a large cross where you aim (Theresa Rapual, who taught the Vermillion children). Two 6-block lines cross at the aim point: up to 8 foes on them take 8 base damage and burn for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.combo_eruption: Combo Eruption - the arms spread wide and a series of fireballs flies at the target (Dmitri Brint). Four fireballs, three ticks apart, each swelling and exploding on contact: up to 8 foes within 2.4 blocks of each take 6 base damage and burn for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_water.aqua_curtain: Aqua Curtain - a large volume of water covers you and puts out the fire on your body (Rhya). Four seconds in which fire is put out again and again and what flies at you within 3.5 blocks is turned aside, then fire resistance and four hearts of absorption for 15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_water.cascade_destroyer: Cascade Destroyer - several balls of water are thrown at the opponents (Selena Silva). Four homing balls two ticks apart, 6 base damage each.
nusmp.page.book_water.holy_water_assassi: Holy Water Assassination Bullet - one bullet of holy water that passes through everything in a line (Solid Silva, who used it on the soul corpses). 13 base damage to up to 8 foes in 34 blocks, 22 to the undead.
nusmp.page.book_wind.slicing_wind_empero: Slicing Wind Emperor: Wintry Wind - several swords of wind are made and sent at the opponents (Fanzell Kruger). Four homing blades, 6 base damage each and a small push.
Slicing Wind Emperor: Gale - a plunge at the opponent with great force, surrounded by wind (Fanzell Kruger). A dash of up to 9 blocks through everything on the way: 9 base damage.
Slicing Wind Emperor: Mountain Retreat - a very strong gust of wind sends the opponents flying a great distance (Fanzell Kruger). A cone of 8 blocks: 4 base damage and a heavy push.

Slicing Wind Emperor: Whirlwind - the sword is swung and whirlwinds bind the opponent's limbs and hold it in the air (Fanzell Kruger; Wind Restraining Magic). One foe within 14 blocks is held and lifted for a moment; shares the control lock of the other binding spells.
nusmp.page.book_wind.killing_kakara_blad: Killing Kakara Blade - you fly past the opponent and wind blades slash it from several angles (Jozou Hanegatsuji). A dash of up to 10 blocks: 8 base damage to everything on the way.
nusmp.page.book_wind.piercing_tornado_ne: Piercing Tornado Needle - a thin needle of wind, wind-based Creation Magic (George of the Eye of the Midnight Sun). It goes through everything in a line of 20 blocks: 10 base damage; a small tornado stands where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_star: Black Star - a small black sphere is made where you aim and pulls the opponents in (Ichika Yami). For a second everything within 4.5 blocks is dragged to it: up to 8 foes take 5.5 base damage and are thrown off balance.
nusmp.page.book_ice.heavenly_ice_fang: Heavenly Ice Fang - a large icicle rises from the ground and strikes the target, with more blunt and cutting than piercing force (Heath Graice). One foe within 24 blocks: 11 base damage, frost and a lift.
nusmp.page.book_ice.icicle_bridge: Icicle Bridge - a large chunk of jagged ice is made and, once released, extends towards the target. A line of 16 blocks: 7 base damage, slowness and frost.
nusmp.page.book_ice.dissolve: Dissolve - you raise a hand and melt any ice at once, whether real or magical, so it can be used against an enemy's ice spells and against your own when they are reflected (Heath Graice). The frost on you and your allies within 6 blocks is gone, you stop burning, and up to 6 spells flying at you are undone.
nusmp.page.book_ice.crystal_ice_shield: Crystal Ice Shield - a shield of crystal ice stands round you (Heath Graice). Ten seconds of absorption (six hearts) and a little damage resistance.
nusmp.page.book_beast.bear_claw: Bear Claw - the arms are wrapped in an aura shaped like a bear's paws that greatly raises the strength of the punch; it can be extended and enlarged (Vetto). A cone of 3.6 blocks: 13 base damage and a push.
nusmp.page.book_beast.cheetah_charge: Cheetah Charge - the legs are wrapped in an aura shaped like a cheetah's, a close-range burst of speed (Vetto). A dash of up to 11 blocks through everything on the way (8 base damage) and three seconds of speed.
nusmp.page.book_beast.rhinoceros_armor: Rhinoceros Armor - an aura shaped like a rhinoceros that can stop powerful impacts (Vetto). Twelve seconds of absorption (six hearts) and a little damage resistance.
